_readme: Companion replay scenarios: transcripts run against the real models by tests/companion_replay.py.
Each scenario states the mode it starts in, then one or more user turns with the OUTCOME expected,
not the tool expected, so the set stays valid when the router is restructured.
Outcomes: none | offered | started:<activity id> | exit_asked | exited | exit_declined | dismissed.
'expect' is one outcome or a list of acceptable ones; null means undecided (reported, not scored).
Start mode: 'in_activity' (an activity id) and 'awaiting_exit' (the stop question is open).
'history' is what was said before the first turn. A turn's 'assistant' is the scripted reply that
follows it; 'only_if' (free | activity | awaiting_exit) skips a turn the earlier ones made moot.
Tags: ordinary = a plain activity answer that must not be read as leaving; noise = garbled or hallucinated transcription; review = the expectation itself is a judgment
call worth a second look; wind_down = going to sleep, asked or not.
